ValidationRule.description: The Account Internal Name field must be populated in order to move the Opp to "Closed"
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT(ISNEW()) && Account.Internal_Name__c = null && RecordType.Name = "Mobile Opp" && ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed")
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Since this is a mobile opportunity, you may not move it to the "Closed" Stage without the Account Internal Name field field populated.
